field.label: Correction reason
field.helpText: Why this invoice corrects the one above ("przyczyna korekty") — carried onto the KSeF submission as FA(3)'s own PrzyczynaKorekty element (formats/national/fa3-provider.ts) once a corrected invoice is set.

field.label: Supply type
field.helpText: Whether this line is a delivery of goods or a supply of services — it decides how a cross-border sale is taxed. Goods sold to a consumer in another EU member state are an intra-Community distance sale, taxed where they arrive once your EU-wide distance sales pass EUR 10 000 in a calendar year (Directive 2006/112/EC art. 33(a) and art. 59c); the same sale as a service stays taxable here (art. 45). Optional: a line that declares nothing is treated as a supply of services.

notes: Poland's own field overlay — a SINGLE addition, `correctionReason`, conditionally required (`requiredIfPresent: "correctsInvoiceId"` — descriptors/types.ts) rather than unconditionally: `correctsInvoiceId` (invoice.descriptor.ts trunk field) is what actually flags an invoice as a correction, so an ORDINARY Polish invoice (the overwhelming majority) never has to carry a reason at all — only once `correctsInvoiceId` is set does this field become mandatory on THIS screen. IMPORTANT PROVENANCE NUANCE, read before assuming this is a legal citation: the reason is legally OPTIONAL, not mandatory. Art. 106j ust. 2 (the faktura korygująca's own MANDATORY content list) does not list a reason at all — verbatim: "2. Faktura korygująca powinna zawierać: ... 2a) numer identyfikujący w Krajowym Systemie e-Faktur fakturę, której dotyczy faktura korygująca ...; 3) dane zawarte w fakturze ...; 5) jeżeli korekta wpływa na zmianę podstawy opodatkowania lub kwoty podatku należnego – odpowiednio kwotę korekty ...; 6) w przypadkach innych niż wskazane w pkt 5 – prawidłową treść korygowanych pozycji." The reason lives ONE paragraph down, in the file's own OPTIONAL list: "2a. Faktura korygująca może zawierać: 1) wyrazy \"FAKTURA KORYGUJĄCA\" albo \"KOREKTA\"; 2) przyczynę korekty." ("może" = may/can, not "powinna"/"musi") — ustawa o VAT z 11 marca 2004 r., tekst jednolity Dz.U. 2025 poz. 775, art. 106j ust. 2 i 2a (isap.sejm.gov.pl, checked 2026-09-16, raw consolidated text — same source correction-routes/data/pl.json's own AUTHORITY_ANNULMENT citation already reads). Requiring it here is therefore a PRODUCT decision (a correction naming no reason at all is a poor audit trail, and the Ministry's own FA(3) schema still exposes PrzyczynaKorekty as an element worth filling even though the underlying statute never forces it), not a legal `kind: 'legal'`-grade fact the way `correction-routes/data/pl.json`'s own CORRECTIVE_INVOICE route citation is — this file's own schema (`country-fields/schema.ts`) does not require field-overlay operations to carry provenance at all (see that file's own header: 'add/modify/remove this field' is a structural/product fact, not itself a new legal claim), which is exactly the case here. The FIELD's own server-side enforcement (never trusted from the screen alone) needs NO bespoke code at all: `requiredIfPresent` is read generically by `descriptors/validate.ts#validateAgainstDescriptor`, which `documents.service.ts#runAction` already runs, against the MERGED descriptor, for every action on this type (save-draft included) — a Polish invoice with `correctsInvoiceId` set and no `correctionReason` is refused (400, naming the field) before any handler ever sees it, proven end to end by `43-correction-routes.cy.ts`'s own Poland describe block. SECOND OPERATION, added later: the SAME `supplyType` line subfield France's own `fr.json` already adds, byte-identical in key, kind, label, options and optionality — a LINE subfield, unlike `correctionReason` above. WHY THE FIELD IS IDENTICAL IN ALL FIVE COUNTRIES RATHER THAN A PER-COUNTRY VARIANT: what reads it — `tax/resolve-invoice-tax.ts`, feeding `tax/tax-engine.ts#determineLineTax` — branches on the goods/services distinction of Directive 2006/112/EC (arts. 32, 33(a) and 59c for an intra-Community distance sale of goods, art. 45 for a service), which binds every member state identically; the same reasoning `tax/types.ts`'s own `DistanceSalesRegime` states for art. 59c ('art. 59c applies identically in all of them'). Poland's transposition defines the two in the directive's own terms — « Przez dostawę towarów, o której mowa w art. 5 ust. 1 pkt 1, rozumie się przeniesienie prawa do rozporządzania towarami jak właściciel » (ustawa o VAT, art. 7 ust. 1) against « Przez świadczenie usług, o którym mowa w art. 5 ust. 1 pkt 1, rozumie się każde świadczenie na rzecz osoby fizycznej, osoby prawnej lub jednostki organizacyjnej niemającej osobowości prawnej, które nie stanowi dostawy towarów w rozumieniu art. 7 » (same act, art. 8 ust. 1), the residual definition the directive itself uses. Same consolidated text this file's own art. 106j citation above already reads — ustawa z 11 marca 2004 r. o podatku od towarów i usług, tekst jednolity Dz.U. 2025 poz. 775 — but fetched from a DIFFERENT host on 2026-09-21: isap.sejm.gov.pl now answers an automated request with an Incapsula challenge page rather than the PDF, so the text was read from the Dziennik Ustaw itself (https://dziennikustaw.gov.pl/D2025000077501.pdf), the same obwieszczenie. WHAT IS DELIBERATELY NOT MIRRORED FROM FRANCE: the French overlay's own `helpText` names BT-23 (« cadre de facturation »), which is a FRENCH obligation — `formats/semantic/business-process.ts#resolveFrenchBusinessProcessCode` derives that code only for a seller whose country has an active BT-23 rule in `content-requirements/`, and France is the only country with one — so a Polish seller declaring a supply type changes the exported document not at all; it changes the TAX determination, which is what this operation's own help text names instead. NO RETROACTIVE EFFECT ON STORED DOCUMENTS: the field is OPTIONAL and nothing back-fills it. `resolve-invoice-tax.ts` narrows a line's raw `supplyType` to GOODS/SERVICES and treats anything else — including absent — as SERVICES, emitting a named warning; that fallback is untouched here, so every invoice stored before this operation existed resolves exactly as it did before, and only a line a user explicitly marks as goods reaches the distance-sales branch. DIGITAL IS NOT OFFERED, on purpose: `tax/types.ts`'s own `SupplyType` has a third value, but `resolve-invoice-tax.ts` narrows a stored value to GOODS/SERVICES only, so a 'DIGITAL' option would be silently discarded on the way in — offering it would need that narrowing widened first, for all five countries including France.
